snippet.title: The Land of Stuff 2D MMORPG demo
snippet.description: A small demo of The Land of Stuff, a new 2d MMORPG coming out soon! Visit http://www.landofstuff.net/ to download the client. Registration is in-game. I won't keep the server on all the time until I have enough users, so please check it out!
